title: Which construct fits the need?
prompt: Place each customer need with the construct built to serve it.

pairs.item: We need the same discovery methodology applied consistently by every consultant.
pairs.why: Use skills when you need repeatable methodology, domain expertise, or consistent reasoning.

pairs.item: We need a write to our in-house claims system with validation before submit.
pairs.why: Use custom actions for deterministic execution against an internal API, legacy system, or proprietary workflow.

pairs.item: We want one tool integration reused across Cursor, Claude, and VS Code.
pairs.why: Use MCP when you want open-standard interoperability and reusable tool access across ecosystems.

pairs.item: We need a nightly run that reads new tickets and files summaries.
pairs.why: Use agents when you need scheduled, event-driven, or governed end-to-end workflows.

takeaway: That decision rule is the whole module. Name the job, then pick the primitive.
